title: Login form accepts a very long (2000-character) username without client-side truncation or error
preconditions: No maxLength, pattern, or native required HTML attributes exist on the username/password inputs (Angular reactive-form validation only, confirmed via DOM query)
steps: Enter a 2000-character string into the Username field
expected_result: No client-side length validation blocks submission or truncates the input. A POST /api/login request is sent. The server responds 401 (treated as invalid credentials, not a request error). No visible error message appears on the page; the user remains on /login.

title: Login form accepts a whitespace-only username without client-side validation
steps: Enter "   " (three spaces, no other characters) into the Username field
expected_result: Whitespace-only input is not treated as 'empty' by the form's required validator, so no client-side 'Username is required' message appears. A POST /api/login request is sent. The server responds 401. The user remains on /login with no visible feedback.

title: POST /api/login with an empty JSON body returns 401, not 400
steps: Send the request described in Test Data to the resolved environment's base URL
expected_result: Response status is 401 (the API does not distinguish a malformed/empty request from wrong credentials; it never returns 400 for this input). Response body is empty.

title: POST /api/login with empty string username and password returns 401
steps: Send the request described in Test Data to the resolved environment's base URL
expected_result: Response status is 401. Response body is empty.

title: POST /api/login with a 2000-character username returns 401, not a request-size error
steps: Send the request described in Test Data to the resolved environment's base URL
expected_result: Response status is 401. The API accepts the oversized field rather than rejecting it with a 400/413-class error. Response body is empty.

title: POST /api/login with a whitespace-only username returns 401
steps: Send the request described in Test Data to the resolved environment's base URL
expected_result: Response status is 401. Response body is empty.
